name: Kemonomichi ~Shiro no Setsuna~
source:
A girl with a sword attacks the main character!

This is where this story begins.

The protagonist, who has lost his memory, and the girl.

He becomes embroiled in a battle with a huge organization.

The existence of a lab conducting mysterious research.

The mystery of the glowing red eyes...

An old man in a wheelchair and a girl with a prosthetic arm accompanying him...

A photographer who pursues the truth.

An old detective and his subordinate.

The existence of blacksmiths who create magic swords.

A researcher and his daughter who belong to the organization.

The ultimate sword technique, "Curved Sword Wind and Moon Style".

When the protagonist regains his memory, the whole truth becomes clear.

What awaits you ahead is...

"Infinite sadness" ?

"The presence of a loved one "

A new mystery ...

Pleasure is not just sexual pleasure.

This game will teach you...

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060106022822/http://www111.sakura.ne.jp/~game/kemonomichi/siro.html]official website[/url]]
